summary: Tested the new Radish QMS Goods-Movement wiring end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_goods_movement.py) - live dry-run call to https://qms.radishtechnologies.com/api returns {ok:true, dry_run:true, external_id:'MOV-XXXXXX', envelope} with the picked source warehouse, typed target bin and derived OwnerPartyInternalID (RI/RT) correctly rendered in the SOAP envelope; RadishQMSClient logs in exactly ONCE for 2 consecutive goods_movement() calls (verified via a monkeypatched _login counter: 1 login, access_token cookie reused, 1.34s -> 0.10s), distinct external_ids per call. POST /api/store-requests/{id}/issue verified via direct Mongo reads: components[].goods_movement populated only when issued_qty>0 AND warehouse AND owner_party_id AND target_logistics_area_id are all present, None otherwise (no-warehouse, no-bin, issued_qty=0 cases all None). Regression: omitting target_logistics_area_id entirely still returns 200/resolved with correct shortfall math; partial + send_to_planner still fires the movement and sets partial_pending_planner; duplicate issue -> 400 'no longer pending', unknown id -> 404, blank actor -> 400. production_confirmation_service._check_availability_against_stock() now carries locations[].owner = company_code. Frontend (/storeapproval, unauthenticated): 'Issue From' Select renders one option per location labelled 'Warehouse (Stock Status) · Owner', single-location component auto-selects, multi-location shows 'Pick warehouse'; Target Bin input present with the optional placeholder; submitting with warehouse+bin shows 'Dry Run OK (MOV-483404)' in blue (#175CD3) for both components; submitting with a blank bin / no warehouse shows grey 'not moved' with no error and the approval still resolves (backward compatible).

minor.issue: The picked source warehouse/owner_party_id are NOT persisted on components[] - they only survive inside the goods_movement.envelope XML string. After resolution the 'Issue From' column has nothing to render, and the journal/audit can't answer 'which bin did the store issue from' without parsing SOAP XML. Suggest storing warehouse/owner_party_id (and target_logistics_area_id at doc level) alongside issued_qty.

First public-URL call after any file write into /app/backend returned HTTP 502 for ~30s (uvicorn hot reload). Environmental only - re-run passed; noting because it produces false failures for the next agent.

ui_bugs.issue: The new 6-column table overflows its wrapper which uses `overflow-hidden` (measured: table scrollWidth 712 vs wrapper clientWidth 684, overflow-x: hidden at 1920px). In the pending state the last column 'SAP Stock Movement' header and cell text are visually clipped ('SAP STO/MOVEM...', 'not move') and cannot be scrolled into view. Real SAP warehouse names are much longer than the test data, so this will get worse. Fix: use `overflow-x-auto` on the wrapper (the queue table already does) or widen the detail container beyond max-w-3xl.

For components that DID move, the post-submit 'Issue From' cell renders an empty string (`c.goods_movement?.attempted ? (sourceWarehouse[...] != null ? "" : "—") : "—"`) - a blank cell that also depends on transient local state, so it is always blank after a page refresh. Should show the actual source warehouse (needs the backend to persist it).
React console warning on first selection: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' - the Select value is `undefined` until picked. Pass "" (or keep a defined value) instead of undefined.

issues: 'not moved' uses #98A2B3 on white (~2.6:1) - below WCAG AA for 11px text; same pre-existing palette issue as 'no stock at this site'.

No hint next to the Issue From dropdown that leaving it (or the Target Bin) blank silently skips the SAP movement - the only hint is inside the Target Bin placeholder, which disappears once text is typed.

action_items: Change the detail table wrapper from overflow-hidden to overflow-x-auto (or widen max-w-3xl) so the 'SAP Stock Movement' column is not clipped.

Persist the chosen warehouse/owner_party_id (and the request-level target_logistics_area_id) on the store_requests components so the resolved view/journal can show 'issued from X -> Y' without parsing the SOAP envelope; then render it in the 'Issue From' cell instead of an empty string.
Give the Issue From Select a defined value ("") to kill the controlled/uncontrolled React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: radish_qms_client._post(): the 403/5xx/JSON checks are OUTSIDE the `with self.lock` block but reference `resp`, which is assigned inside - correct today, but if a future refactor adds an early return inside the lock this becomes an UnboundLocalError. Also 401-on-retry is not re-checked, so a second 401 falls through to the generic >=400 branch with a confusing message.

store_approval_service._trigger_goods_movement() only catches RadishQMSError - a requests.Timeout/ConnectionError (very likely for an external SAP-backed service) will propagate and 500 the whole issue endpoint, aborting an approval the code explicitly says must never be blocked by a failed movement. Catch Exception (or requests.RequestException) there.

The goods movement is fired inside the per-component loop BEFORE any Mongo write, and one call took 1.3s (cold login); a request with N components makes N sequential external calls with the whole endpoint blocked in asyncio.to_thread - acceptable now, but consider a per-call timeout budget.
GOODS_MOVEMENT_DRY_RUN is a module constant, not env-driven - flipping to real writes requires a code deploy; an env var (default True) would be safer.
Whole-envelope XML (~1.5KB) is stored per component per request; fine at current volume, but consider trimming once dry_run is turned off.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (2 UI polish bugs found, none blocking)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted synthetic pending store_requests (requesters TEST_QA_GM via pytest, TEST_QA_GM_UI = P2-000017/P2-000018 for the UI run). All removed; the 5 pre-existing real store_requests untouched. All Radish calls were dry_run=True - no SAP writes. Backend log shows expected '_resume_order_creation_job: job TEST_JOB_GM* missing payload_snapshot' errors from these synthetic jobs only.
test_credentials: None needed - /storeapproval is unauthenticated; Radish QMS creds already in backend/.env and live-verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python /app/tests/_seed_gm_request.py` to create 2 fresh pending requests (P2-0000NN, site P2, 1 multi-location + 1 single-location component with owner RI/RT) and `... cleanup` to remove them. Goods-movement pytest: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_goods_movement.py -v` (hits the LIVE Radish dry-run endpoint, safe). Note request IDs are now '{site}-000123' (not SR-XXXXXX as in iteration 97). Writing any file into /app/backend triggers a uvicorn reload -> first public-URL call 502s for ~30s.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect in the new integration. The clipped 'SAP Stock Movement' column is caused by the detail table wrapper's `overflow-hidden` class combined with max-w-3xl now that a 6th column was added. The blank 'Issue From' cell after submit is caused by the backend not persisting the chosen warehouse plus a frontend expression that renders "" when local sourceWarehouse state happens to be set.
